description: Data layer robustness: Fix error handling, timeout handling, NaN/None safety, and ensure all data sources work properly together
steps: In src/augur/data.py - fetch_market_context: ensure ValueError from _normalize_ticker returns a graceful empty MarketContext with data_source='error' rather than propagating exception to callers
In src/augur/data.py - fetch_market_overview: add per-ticker timeout protection so one slow/failed ticker does not block others (use ThreadPoolExecutor with individual 10s timeouts)
In src/augur/data.py - fetch_hot_tickers: same per-ticker timeout protection
In src/augur/datasources/stooq_provider.py: verify CSV parsing handles edge cases (empty lines, extra commas, encoding issues) - add defensive parsing
In src/augur/data.py - fix cache TTL for market_overview (currently subtracting from TTL which means only 60s cache; clarify the intent and ensure consistent caching)
In src/augur/data.py - fix cache TTL for hot_tickers (same issue - currently 90s effective, document and ensure it works)

In dashboard/app.py - /api/sparkline/{ticker}: currently returns dict with 'error' key on exception but does not consistently use {status, data} format - standardize to always return {status: 'ok'/'error', ...}
In dashboard/app.py - /api/hot-tickers: add try-catch around the entire handler so network timeout does not result in 500

In dashboard/app.py - /api/scanner/run: add overall timeout protection for large batch (20 tickers at max 30s each = up to 10 min), add progress streaming or at least a sane overall timeout with partial results
In dashboard/app.py - rate limiter: the comment says 'Max 30 requests per minute' but the check is >= 300 - fix to match documentation (should be 30 per minute or update the message)
acceptance_criteria: python3 -m pytest tests/ passes all existing tests
fetch_market_context('INVALID!!!TICKER') returns MarketContext with data_source attribute rather than raising
Rate limit middleware threshold matches its error message
All API endpoints return consistent JSON format with status field
verification: python3 -c "from augur.data import fetch_market_context; ctx = fetch_market_context('INVALID!!!'); print(getattr(ctx, 'data_source', 'missing'))"
python3 -c "from dashboard.app import app; print('Dashboard imports OK')"
findings: All 9 fixes applied successfully. Added conftest.py with autouse fixture to clear IP rate limit state between tests (prevents cross-test pollution from the 60/min IP limit). ThreadPoolExecutor with 10s timeout added to both fetch_market_overview and fetch_hot_tickers. Invalid ticker handling in fetch_market_context now returns graceful MarketContext with data_source=error.
